run_classification_with_strings: run the vLLM classification client to classify text prompts using string inputs via the /classify endpoint
run_classification_with_token_ids: run the vLLM classification client to classify text prompts using token id inputs via the /classify endpoint
run_tokenization: run the vLLM client to tokenize text prompts and retrieve token ids via the /tokenize endpoint
run_model_listing: run the vLLM client to list available models via the /v1/models endpoint and extract the first model id
run_cli_with_custom_host_port: run the vLLM classification CLI client with a custom host and port argument
